title: AAPS 4.0.0.0-dev-a problems with NSClientV3 Queue
symptom: The NSClientV3 Queue is high (e.g., 48) and does not come down, but after restarting AAPS and the Medtronic MMT754 pump connects, the queue drops to 0. This repeats frequently.
cause: The queue is temporarily high until history is read from the pump; this is Medtronic-specific because loading pump history takes time.
fix: No fix needed; it is a temporary state until history is read from the pump. Restarting AAPS can clear the queue.
evidence_quote: this is only temporary state until history is read from pump. medtronic specific no need to fix it
